pr_title: [ML] Add latest search interval to datafeed stats
pr_body:
This commit adds `search_interval` to the datafeed stats API
`running_state` object. When the datafeed is running, it reports
the last search interval that was searched. It is useful to
understand the point in time where the datafeed is currently
searching.

Closes #82405

issue_context.title: [ML] Add latest search start and end time in datafeed stats
issue_context.body:
When a datafeed is running performing searches that scan a long time period (particularly in lookbacks)
it would be very useful to report where the search is in the stats API. For example, in the scenario where the
datafeed is going through an extended period without any data, it could seem like the job does nothing. But
if the user could see the search time progressing they would understand that the job is progressing fine.
comments: FWIW: In transform the field is called `last_search_time`. I am not sure you need a start _and_ end time, nevertheless :+1:. It is helpful to know if a job is progressing properly.
